results.name: OFF: normal Rizo loads no event CSS/JS and has no event markup
Scheduled, outside window: CSS present but inert, runtime never requested
Schedule switches the event on at its start time without a reload
Schedule switches the event off at its end time and cleans up
Manual override (Always on) ignores the schedule
Theme editor previews the event outside its window (and can opt out)
?rizo_event=on persists across pages for the tab; ?rizo_event=clear and =off work
Each module can be switched off on its own
Signal bar shows the event message only while the event is live
Countdown targets Oct 31 12:00 AM New York regardless of visitor timezone
Countdown target without an offset is read in New York time, not the visitor's
Countdown ticks each second, rewrites only changed digits and never shifts layout
Countdown reaching zero shows the ended message (setting: message)
Countdown reaching zero hides itself (setting: hide) and seconds can be turned off
Server renders an already-past countdown in its ended state (no flash)
Countdown pauses on a hidden tab and resyncs when visible
Clicks and taps pass straight through moving bats
SHOP still shops: hero CTA works with a bat parked on top of it
Rapid tapping (200 taps) keeps the flock bounded
Aggressive scrolling both ways wakes bats but stays bounded
Bats leave and are recycled; the loop sleeps during quiet periods
Exactly one animation loop: at most one event-layer rAF request per frame
Open drawer/menu pauses the flock; closing resumes it
Frame-time governor steps a struggling device down to lite, then still
Theme editor section reloads (x8) never duplicate timers, observers or listeners
Resize and orientation changes keep limits and layout sane
Multiple reloads: one engine per page, no errors
Reduced motion: night, moon, still fog and countdown stay; bats never load
Reduced motion switched on mid-visit stops bats; switched off brings them back
Decorative layers stay out of the accessibility tree; countdown is a labelled timer
Keyboard focus order is identical with the event on and off
Quick add (variant + single-variant), cart drawer, cart page and checkout work with bats flying
Product page: variant picker, sold-out state, add to cart and sticky bar with the event live
Menu, search and newsletter form work with the event live
Every page type loads without errors with the event live
Event layer adds no horizontal overflow at 320, 375, 390, 430, landscape, tablet and desktop widths
Performance sample: frame pacing (event Off vs On) while the page scrolls; event asset weight
